blocks.text: Digitalization has brought formal credit closer to Filipinos long been failed by traditional financial infrastructure that was never built for them. But as the industry expands, access alone is no longer enough. True financial inclusion also requires consumers to have the information, flexibility, and control to make credit work for their lives. For global credit infrastructure company Tala, that means looking beyond the availability of credit to the experience surrounding it: how borrowers are treated, how regulation responds to different models of lending, and how data can help financial institutions better understand people who remain difficult to assess through conventional systems.
